labels.raw_data_evidence: No emergency deployment context in wearable data.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No reported bad night or insomnia symptoms in data.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No workplace or meeting information in wearable data.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No travel history recorded in wearable data.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Window steps are high (~7927/day), not low or declining.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No shift work or caffeine intake recorded.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No meal timing or size information in wearable data.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No personal preferences or availability recorded.

labels.raw_data_evidence: All sleep occurs overnight (start ~22:42-22:58, end 07:00).

labels.raw_data_evidence: Activity duration ~55 min/day while steps vary widely (2565-8320).

labels.raw_data_evidence: Device low movement is not confirmed sitting; intensity unknown.

labels.raw_data_evidence: 14-day window only; no reported sleeping difficulties.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Activity intervals occur 21:00-~22:00 daily, but intensity is unknown.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No stair access or mobility context recorded.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No screen or light exposure information recorded.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No reported difficulty relaxing or request for routine options.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Activity intensity is unknown for all recorded intervals.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Activity intensity is unknown for all recorded intervals.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Window steps are high (~7927/day), not recently low or inactive.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No caffeine history recorded in wearable data.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Sleep duration ~7.8h; no subjective refreshment data recorded.

labels.raw_data_evidence: 14-day window only; no symptom history recorded.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Wake time is exactly 07:00 daily (1140 min from noon); no insomnia symptoms.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Activity intensity is unknown for all intervals.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No breathing or talk-test observations recorded.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Sleep duration ~7.8h consistently; no evidence of insufficient sleep.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Activity and sleep available, but temporal co-occurrence doesn't imply causation.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No tiredness or energy history recorded.
